review_description: Customer service that you can’t complain about. Installation very neat and tidy. This is the third thing we have been back to them for ,couldn’t be happier. Thanks Ben and Jade.

We were disappointed by the poor follow up of some of the firms we contacted and the time that elapsed before following up the initial contact.(Promises-promises!!)- some were quite vague apart from the cost $'sThe firm we chose specializes in Solar and Satellite installation  both domestic and caravan / mobile applications and unlike some firms, FULLY explained the situation which we appreciated.The installer kept in contact and was "on time" on each occasion- a rarity these days!!We are extremely satisfied!
